description: Provider-lifecycle telemetry events for operation registration, seven-state lifecycle transitions and their refusals, verification-TTL expiry and AC-270 refresh, deprecation detection and sunset incidents, time-bounded migration exceptions, metadata-only response quarantine, sixteen-field rights changes with fail-closed use decisions and artifact actions, activation-readiness blocks, and source fingerprints. Quarantine events carry hashes, field paths, and sizes only — never payload or key material; no event ever reports an unreasoned state change.
contractStatus: DECLARATIVE_CONTRACT_ONLY — this file defines the event contracts the requirement manifest maps to (telemetry/prov.*); emitter wiring lands with the observability milestone (dependency group G2), so nothing publishes these event names yet. Field lists mirror the authoritative schemas in packages/shared-schemas/src/prov.ts exactly.

events.name: operation.registered
events.description: A versioned provider operation definition entered the registry after registration-time validation refused prohibited capability classes; the operation starts at lifecycle state DISCOVERED.

fields.name: currentState
fields.notes: §12.11 seven-state alphabet; always DISCOVERED at first registration of a version.

fields.name: capabilityClass
fields.notes: §15.2 vocabulary minus the PROHIBITED_* classes, which are unrepresentable at registration.

fields.name: deprecatedAt
fields.notes: Null unless the registered version is already deprecated.

fields.name: replacementOperationId
fields.notes: Replacement pointer consumed by the decoder-authority validator and §15.4 rule 5 replay resolution.

fields.name: verificationExpiresAt
fields.notes: Earliest expiry across the operation's verification kinds (§15.3).

fields.name: forbiddenOutputFields
fields.notes: Output fields stripped before any persistence or model-context reach.

fields.name: negativeCapabilities
fields.notes: Non-empty on every registered operation — the scan-surface metadata demanded by AC-254.

events.name: lifecycle.transitioned
events.description: A guarded lifecycle transition validated against the legal transition graph and appended to the immutable prov_lifecycle_events ledger under its idempotency key.

fields.name: reasonClass
fields.notes: Stable machine code from the registry's reason-class vocabulary — transitions without a required reason class refuse.

fields.name: idempotencyKey
fields.notes: UNIQUE fence — retries cannot double-append (INV-009); historical evidence is never mutated.

events.name: lifecycle.transition_refused
events.description: A lifecycle transition was refused fail-closed because the legal graph, reason-class rule, or fencing rejected it; the projected current state is unchanged.

fields.name: refusalReason
fields.notes: Typed machine reason (illegal edge, missing reason class, duplicate idempotency key, …).

fields.name: currentState
fields.notes: Equals attemptedFromState — a refusal never moves the projection.

events.name: verification.expired
events.description: A verification record lapsed its configured TTL under the injected clock; new active use of decision-critical fields is prevented until reverification and the §15.4 rule-3 health outcome was applied.

fields.name: healthOutcome
fields.notes: §15.4 rule 3 mapping; the paired out-of-ACTIVE movement is its own lifecycle.transitioned event.

events.name: verification.refreshed
events.description: A verification kind was re-proven within TTL; active decision-critical use resumes only when BOTH the OFFICIAL_DOC and LIVE_CONTRACT verifications of the lapsed kind hold (AC-270 pair rule).

fields.name: evidenceRefs
fields.notes: Non-empty — every verification record carries its evidence references.

fields.name: expiresAt
fields.notes: verifiedAt plus the configured per-kind/per-provider TTL.

fields.name: activeUseRestored
fields.notes: True only when both pair members are current; a single-source refresh leaves active use blocked.

events.name: deprecation.detected
events.description: An operation's deprecatedAt became effective: new feature-dependency registration is blocked unless a valid migration exception exists, and sunset handling is armed.

fields.name: replacementOperationId
fields.notes: Required for the replacement path; null records an unresolved replacement (which blocks sole-critical-source use).

fields.name: newDependenciesBlocked
fields.notes: Always true while no valid time-bounded migration exception covers the operation (§15.4 rule 1).

events.name: sunset.incident_raised
events.description: A sunset date or official deprecation notice raised an incident through the security incidents API with a migration deadline (§15.4 rule 2).

events.name: migration_exception.granted
events.description: A time-bounded migration exception bound to an approved replacement plan was granted for a deprecated operation; it authorizes only until its expiry instant.

fields.name: replacementPlanRef
fields.notes: Approved replacement-plan reference — exceptions without one do not grant.

fields.name: exceptionExpiresAt
fields.notes: Strictly after grantedAt; evaluated at use time against the injected clock — no grace windows.

events.name: migration_exception.expired
events.description: A migration exception lapsed by expiry or revocation; the deprecated operation re-blocked automatically at use time (fail-closed).

events.name: response.quarantined
events.description: A provider response matching one of the five malicious-response classes was rejected, quarantined metadata-only, audited, and excluded from model context. No payload-body field exists anywhere in the quarantine schema — hazardous material is structurally unpersistable.

fields.name: detectedClasses
fields.notes: The five FR-PROV-008 classes; non-empty.

fields.name: fieldPaths
fields.notes: Paths of the offending fields — structure only, never values.

fields.name: payloadSha256
fields.notes: sha256:<hex> of the rejected bytes — never the bytes themselves; private-key material is not persisted even for forensics.

fields.name: disposition
fields.notes: Constant — quarantine intake is always a rejection.

fields.name: modelContextExclusion
fields.notes: Constant CHECK — exclusion from evidence/model context is recorded as enforced, never assumed.

events.name: rights.changed
events.description: A versioned change of the sixteen-field data-rights matrix was recorded, naming the use paths that became newly prohibited for affected storage, derived use, redistribution, caching, export, and model-use decisions.

fields.name: newlyProhibitedUses
fields.notes: Empty arrays are valid only for pure loosening changes — loosening never silently reactivates paths without reverification.

events.name: rights.use_blocked
events.description: The immediate fail-closed rights decision API refused requested use paths against the rights version captured at evaluation — a tightening applies to new attempts instantly.

fields.name: evaluatedRightsVersion
fields.notes: Rights version governing this decision — artifacts captured under older versions re-evaluate against it.

fields.name: blockedPaths
fields.notes: Subset of requestedPaths refused under the evaluated matrix; non-empty on this event.

fields.name: rightsChangeId
fields.notes: Change driving newly prohibited refusals; null for pre-existing prohibitions.

events.name: rights.action_executed
events.description: A previously stored restricted artifact was enumerated by a rights tightening and its QUARANTINE or RETIRE action executed durably — enumeration is complete, with no silent retention.

fields.name: artifactObjectRef
fields.notes: Object-store reference registered at capture time.

fields.name: action
fields.notes: Per the updated rights policy — never deletion-by-rewrite; states move ACTIVE → QUARANTINED|RETIRED.

events.name: readiness.blocked
events.description: The provider-side activation-readiness evaluator held BLOCKED with typed reasons over rights verification, lifecycle state, verification freshness, migration-exception validity, and prohibited-operation exposure (AC-272 inputs to the future workspace/public gate).

fields.name: blockedReasons
fields.notes: Non-empty — BLOCKED never holds without typed reasons; ELIGIBLE evaluations emit no event.

events.name: fingerprint.captured
events.description: A source fingerprint of one of the six kinds was captured as canonical JSON and stored versioned for the future empirical dependence estimator (INV-008: provider count is not source independence).

fields.name: payloadSha256
fields.notes: sha256:<hex> of the canonical JSON fingerprint bytes; the store keeps the canonical payload and estimator-input references.

fields.name: estimatorInputRefs
fields.notes: References to the raw inputs the dependence estimator will consume (§15.7).
